path_convention: Paths beginning source-archives/ are relative to the local multi-repository workspace, outside ambisgis-platform; they are not repository-hosted download links.
method: Verified authenticated owner aloerch and matched live owned repository ID, exact owner/name, public visibility and donor parent against the bootstrap receipt before each clone.
Cloned owned HTTPS origins with complete Git history, no checkout, no recursion into submodules, no depth limit, and no object filter.
Fetched all branch and tag refs from the owned origin without forced ref updates; added no donor remote.
Matched clone HEAD to the bootstrap-observed default commit, checked absent shallow/partial markers, and ran git fsck --connectivity-only.
Created git bundle --all archives, verified them with git bundle verify, compared every archived ref and HEAD to the recorded clone refs, and calculated actual archive SHA256 and size.
Confirmed every bundle header contains zero external Git-object prerequisites. No clean-restore or disconnected-build result is implied.
Read license bytes using git show at the recorded owned commits, verified each Git blob identity, retained original bytes separately, and calculated SHA256.
